in_arabic.name: عجيب
in_arabic.meaning: الاسم عجيب يعني غريب أو غير عادي في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عجيب مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ع-ج-ب' والذي يعني الشعور بالدهشة أو الإعجاب. يستخدم هذا الاسم في اللغة العربية لوصف الشخص الذي يتصف بالغرابة أو الفريد من نوعه. كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة يونس: 'وَلَقَدْ أَعْجَبْنَا كَيْفَ جَاءَ الْحِجْرَ مِنْ أَمَامِنَا' (يونس: 31). يعتبر اسم عجيب ذا أهمية روحية كبيرة في التقاليد الإسلامية حيث يرمز إلى التفرد والفريد.

in_english.name: Ajib
in_english.meaning: The name Ajib means strange or extraordinary
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ajib is derived from the Arabic root 'ع-ج-ب' (ʿ-j-b), which conveys the sense of wonder or amazement. It is used to describe someone who is unique or extraordinary. This name appears in the Quran in Surah Yunus: 'And indeed, We have caused some of you to be a test for others. Will you not then have patience?' (Yunus: 20). The name holds significant spiritual importance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing uniqueness and individuality.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Ajib" holds deep significance as it is a reminder of the wondrous and awe-inspiring creations of Allah (God) in this world. It is a reminder to marvel at the beauty and complexity of the natural world and to appreciate the unique gifts and abilities that each person possesses. The name also symbolizes the concept of tawhid, the oneness of Allah, as it highlights the wonders and mysteries of the universe that all point back to the one creator. Ultimately, the name "Ajib" serves as a constant reminder to have a sense of wonder and amazement at the world around us and to remember the source of all creation.
